name: BoxSpecV1
status: S1 (launch pipeline v1 § 1 and § 4): the single source of the BoxSpec wire format, its checks and its fixed values. Nothing here is deployed.
about: One BoxSpec fully describes a box. The factory (S7) will check it with validate(), build the box from it and store specHash() in the registry.

packages/box-spec/scripts/generate.mjs writes packages/contracts/src/box/BoxSpecV1.sol (struct, constants, validate(), specHash()), packages/box-spec/src/generated/*.ts (types, zod schema, the same validate() and specHash()) and the shared vectors packages/contracts/test/vectors/box-spec/box-spec-v1.json. `pnpm check:box-spec` fails when any of them is stale.
Wire format: every enum is a uint8 (0 is never a member), so an out-of-range value decodes and is refused with a reason instead of reverting the decoder. specHash = keccak256(abi.encode(spec)).

validate(spec, ctx) returns (reason, field): the first failing check in this order: the fields in `fields` order (the add-on list is the last field and is checked entry by entry, each entry's params and `requires` included), then `rules` in order. Both implementations follow this order, so they return the same pair. `ctx` is the version context (`contexts`): what the version, not the creator, chooses: the curated Q list and the allowed graduated layout(s).

Strings are checked as the bytes on the wire. The TypeScript twin validates and hashes raw ABI bytes with validateEncodedBoxSpecV1() and specHashOfEncoded() (an ABI decoder that yields JS strings loses a leading BOM and invalid UTF-8); its JS-string API (validateBoxSpecV1, specHash) is for specs it builds itself, such as the creation page's.

Fixed per version, never per box (plan § 1): `constants` (status V = read in code or a decision row, P = a proposal; `slice` = the slice that builds or fixes the value), `fixedLater` (fixed per version, no value yet), the add-on catalog's constants, and each context's Q list and graduated layouts.

F55 (2026-10-02, founder): keep the core minimal; extras are add-ons from add-ons.v1.json, carried as (id, ABI-encoded params) in `addOns`. Placeholders are a general add-on any new-collection box may choose; the hidden picture and texts are its params, not core fields.

Founder answers applied (F61): L7, the graduated layout is ASK_FULL_BID_SENTINEL in every version (B_PRIME stays an enum member, so today's deployed layout b' keeps a name for the layout library's differential tests, but no version offers it); A1, fixed clones for every box's custody contracts, hook included (fixed per version, so no clone-kind field); R4, drand only (RANDOMNESS_SOURCE a pinned constant, no randomness field).

Fee model (F59, F62, F64, F65, F67, F68, F77). Box 0 (F77, 'the Misfits like all the others'): buyers' fees (Q) 11/15 to FIT buy-and-burn (BOX0_FEE_SHARE_FIT), 2/15 into its own pool depth (FEE_SHARE_DEPTH, the same constant as every box's) and 2/15 to the platform (BOX0_FEE_SHARE_PLATFORM); the platform part of box 0's trading fees and royalties is capped at PLATFORM_CAP_WEI per PLATFORM_EPOCH_SECONDS (no carry-over, set in ETH, no price feed) and above the cap the rest goes into box 0's own pool depth too; sellers' fees (T) 13/15 burned, or to the per-item stream after graduation (BOX0_FEE_SHARE_T_BURN; S8), and 2/15 into its own pool depth. Box 0's pool grows by pair and lock like every box's (F72 (B); its ETH-only bid ladder of dynamic-pool-share.md § 1.2 is superseded and no box places rungs). The Misfits' launch-window (sniper) tax goes into box 0's own pool depth after graduation, like every box's (F77 supersedes F68 (1b)); it never reaches the Safe, so the platform earns only box 0's capped 2/15 (F64). Every other box, buyers' fees (Q): 10/15 to its reward side (its stream actions, or creatorFeeRecipient with TO_CREATOR, F68 (3)), 3/15 to FIT buy-and-burn, 2/15 into its own pool depth (FEE_SHARE_DEPTH); sellers' fees (T): 10/15 to its T-stream action (TO_CREATOR: to creatorFeeRecipient in T), 3/15 waiting in the receiver for FIT (fitWaitingT: sold, burned or paired later, founder question 9, P) and 2/15 into its own pool depth by pair and lock (F72 (B): both sides' 2/15 accumulate and are added together as a full-range position the box owns; launch-pipeline-v1.md § 6 question 5 answered); it never pays the platform, and its sniper tax goes into its own pool depth at graduation, or into the refund range if it fails (F68 (2a)). Burns and holder rewards are never used for liquidity (F59). S4 builds the tax routing, S5 the receivers and the cap, S11 the failure path. A creator's fees during the curve are held until graduation and go into the refund range if the box fails (F69 C1). Built in core v1 (S4+S5, V BoxReceiver.sol `_split` and `_creditDepth`, BoxHookExtension `_planDeepen`): every box's 2/15 (box 0's included since F77) is held in the receiver until graduation, then moved whole to the hook's claims, which deepen() pairs at the price; a Q-only inflow (the sniper tax, box 0's platform excess above the cap, POOL_DEPTH royalties, depth gifts) is balanced by deepen()'s depth conversions (R F76; S5.M5, every box since F77, BoxHookExtension `_planConvert` and `_convert`): while the T side is below MIN_ADD each call buys T with at most DEPTH_CONVERT_SHARE_BPS of the unpaired Q within the swap module's bounds (BoxSwapBounds), the T waits as the hook's claims, and the pair follows in the same unlock once both sides reach MIN_ADD.

The creation flow (F70, F71; all P until the founder confirms): a box is a token launch with or without a collection. boxType TOKEN_ONLY ('Nothing' in the flow) is a plain token launch: no NFTs, no vault, every collection field zero (`zeroWhen` on fields 5, 6, 8, 19-22, 24, 25 and 28; field 23, the logo, stays), no collection add-on, version 2 only. Each fee side picks its own kind (creator, holders or burn) and the token it is paid in: QStream and TStream gain CREATOR_IN_T and HOLDERS_IN_T (buyers' fees in Q, converted by a buy) and CREATOR_IN_Q and HOLDERS_IN_Q (sellers' fees in T, converted by a sell); each member carries kind, paidIn and buys/sells for the page (a sell shows one flag line, 'sells {T} for {Q}'); holder payouts per network since F74 (U1, below). Existing values keep their numbers. Add-ons 5 (creator-fee cap per 30 days) and 6 (collection page for contractURI, ERC-7572: banner, teasers, link) join the catalog. Site metadata (website, X and Telegram links) and the creator's rights confirmation are site-level records, not spec fields (`notInTheSpec`).

F74 (2026-10-03, founder, desk round 7). (U5) One raise for every box: 4.206980085 ETH 'equivalent of Q' ('Different sizes confuse people. Other platforms don't have them.'), box 0's R: each version context lists one raise per Q, version 2's native-ETH presets 1 / 4.2 / 10 ETH are gone, field 11 is chosen by the version and the page shows it as a fixed fact; the 'ETH equivalent' rule for other Q is open (S12; only native ETH is listed). (U3) A separate collection cover: field 23 coverSha256 is the logo only (the token's and the box card's picture, committed by the spec hash; no contract argument); the new field 28 collectionCoverSha256 is contractURI's image (the collection clone's cover argument), its own upload, required for NEW_COLLECTION and zero for TOKEN_ONLY (supersedes F70's P 'one picture for logo and cover'). (U1) Holder payouts: offered in Demo now with a visible 'pending legal review' note, on Sepolia once S14 builds them (the core reverts ActionNotBuilt for stream value 7 today), never on mainnet until counsel: each holder member carries `offeredOn` (the networks besides the strictest that offer it) and `pending`; validate(), the factory's check on every chain, stays the strictest and refuses them (NOT_OFFERED); the TypeScript twin takes a network for Demo. (U2) The creator-fee cap (add-on 5) is a fixed amount of Q per 30-day epoch, not a share of the raise; presets 1, 4, 8, 16, 32 ETH (P, founder question U9). U4 (the Misfits banner) needs nothing new here: version 1 offers add-on 6 and box 0 has room for it; its hash is added once the art exists.

F75 (2026-10-03, founder, desk round 8). (W3) The draw pays the drand round's posting: DRAND_BOUNTY_GAS is V, required in BoxTickets.draw from the first draw of a round (add-on 1). (W2) GRADUATION_REWARD_CAP_BPS stays 0.1% of the raise (V). (U9) The creator-fee cap presets 1, 4, 8, 16 and 32 ETH per 30 days are decided (add-on 5). (W1) Every Misfit trait on chain: box 0 loads the full trait table (3,341 bytes at round 7); no 2,048-byte cap on the box path. Core item 9: validate() checks the metadata table's format v1 (METADATA_TABLE_MALFORMED, MAX_TRAIT_TYPES).

F143 (2026-10-20, founder: "(1) sure (2) ok"; amends F61 R4): box 0's randomness source is the BoxBackedSource (RANDOMNESS_SOURCE): drand first through the shared DrandSource (DRAND_SOURCE), and a RANDAO backup fixed at creation, started by an on-chain rule anyone can trigger BACKUP_AFTER_SECONDS (5 days, not 3) and no later than BACKUP_LATEST_START_SECONDS (5 days 18 hours, the security review) after an unposted round's time, one target BACKUP_TARGET_BLOCKS ahead, proved by its header; no Safe or other power. Still no randomness field in a box's spec; core v2 boxes stay drand-only.

Core v1 (S3, S4+S5, S6, S9, merged on main; docs/evidence/SH-core-wave-2.md): the spec describes what is built. Per fee side the payout currency is the stream value itself (F72 (A); no payout-mode field): TO_CREATOR pays as collected; *_HOLDERS_* (7) and PAY_HOLDERS_* need S14, so the receiver reverts ActionNotBuilt at initialize for them; a Standard box builds ALL_TO_FIT or TO_CREATOR (Q) and BURN_T or TO_CREATOR (T) on native ETH, and since S5.M1 its receiver also takes the four actions the swap module converts (BUYBACK_BURN_T and CREATOR_IN_T on the Q side, SELL_FOR_Q and CREATOR_IN_Q on the T side) and books them for its module (V BoxReceiverExtension.sol `initialize`, BoxReceiver.sol `_rewardQ`, `_split`, `pullForModule`); the module that converts them is S5.M2 (S5.M3 for the creator kinds), so they stay off Sepolia until it ships. One payout wallet (F72 (3)): creatorFeeRecipient is the initial creator payee for a creator kind on either side and for royalties to CREATOR (add-on 4 has no recipient), handed over only at the payee's request (proposeCreatorPayee / acceptCreatorPayee). The constants the core fixes are in `constants`, V where built and checked (test/box/BoxSpecV1Vectors.t.sol), P where a founder question or a proposal remains.

constants.name: DEPTH_TIP_BPS

constants.name: DEPTH_PAIR_SALT
constants.source: V BoxHookBase.sol:82 (_SALT_PAIR): pair and lock's full-range position (F72 (B)), every box's since F77 (box 0 included); the curve is salt 0, L7 salt 1; salt 2 (the removed rungs', F77) is never used and not renumbered

constants.name: STREAM_NOTIFY_GAS
constants.source: V BoxReceiver.sol `STREAM_NOTIFY_GAS`: the gas the per-item stream's onStreamFunds gets, capped and fail-safe (as FitPoolHook.sol:159-166). S8 measured BoxItemStream.onStreamFunds with its burn of the items-inside share at 99,555 gas today and 124,880 under Glamsterdam from cold, the least forwarded gas with which it succeeds (BoxItemStreamGas.t.sol; SH-S8-stream § 5); 100,000 (S5) did not fit after Glamsterdam. Kept at 200,000 by F87's review (SH-box0-stream-gas § The notice): 1.60x after Glamsterdam; a failed notice only delays the burn of the items-inside share, while the receiver's settlement inside the graduation poke checks that the whole cap is left (each 50,000 more takes about 51,600 of POKE_GAS's room); 250,000 would need POKE_GAS raised with it (founder question)

constants.name: POKE_GAS
constants.source: F95 R19M (2026-10-06, desk round 19: 'Raise to 2,600,000 (2x)'; F90 R16I's 1,600,000 and S6's 1,000,000 before): V BoxCoordinator.sol:104, with the caller's floor POKE_GAS + POKE_GAS / 63 + 10,000 = 2,651,269 (:120): every graduation poke is capped; every poke is fail-safe, including the stream; F126 / M28 records its baseline before pokes for a lossless delayed retry (BC-098). Measured on box 0 with its stream, each poke alone from cold (Box0StreamCeiling.t.sol; SH-box0-stream-gas § POKE_GAS): under Glamsterdam the receiver's settlement with its notice needs 874,760 and the stream's poke running it 913,836 when a fee batch ran before the close (2.97x, 2.85x), and 1,237,499 and 1,288,181 when the settlement's batch is the box's first (seven slots written from zero: 2.10x, 2.02x; 1.30x and 1.24x at 1,600,000); the tickets' word request 147,292, FIT's executor's sample 138,074, the stream's start 102,555; today at most 515,229 (5.05x). graduate()'s least call gas from cold: 3,598,433-3,762,467 today, 5,425,027-6,410,090 under Glamsterdam (one gas less: GasTooLow); with all four pokes exhausting their budgets graduation succeeds (F126), using at most 11,041,016 execution gas including intrinsic after Amsterdam; its least successful transaction is 13,031,931, under EIP-7825's 16,777,216. Before (S6, S5.M1): a creator box's onGraduation with its first batch final 654,047 under Glamsterdam (3.98x now). Whether other boxes' price sampler and launch router sweep join the pokes is founder question 10 (built: neither)

constants.name: RANDOMNESS_SOURCE
constants.source: V BackedSourcePins.sol:24-25: box 0's one randomness source, BoxBackedSource (F143: drand first through the pinned DrandSource, DRAND_SOURCE; the RANDAO backup fixed at creation, started by an on-chain rule anyone can trigger BACKUP_AFTER_SECONDS after an unposted round's time, one target BACKUP_TARGET_BLOCKS ahead, no Safe or other power; amends F61 R4's drand only, no Chainlink backup), which factory v1 pins on chains 1 and 11155111, the same address on both (the deterministic deployer, salt keccak256('squarehole.box.v1.BoxBackedSource')). Not deployed yet: anyone may send the deterministic deployment (DeployCoreV1 sends it when absent). graduate() does not re-check its code (a failed re-check would freeze a closed box, D1): the factory pins it (S7) and the instance checks re-check it (BC-101). Core v2 boxes stay drand-only (DRAND_SOURCE)

constants.name: RANDOMNESS_SOURCE_CODE_HASH
constants.source: V BackedSourcePins.sol:26-27: RANDOMNESS_SOURCE's runtime code hash on chains 1 and 11155111 (BackedSourcePins.isPinned; F143)

constants.name: DRAND_SOURCE
constants.source: V DrandSourcePins.sol:28-29: the one drand quicknet source every box shares (rounds are posted here; BoxBackedSource.DRAND names it, and core v2 boxes read it directly), pinned on chains 1 and 11155111, the same address on both (the deterministic deployer, salt keccak256('squarehole.box.v1.DrandSource')); factory v1 checks it is there with its pinned code (BC-101, F143)

constants.name: DRAND_SOURCE_CODE_HASH
constants.source: V DrandSourcePins.sol:30-31: DRAND_SOURCE's runtime code hash on chains 1 and 11155111 (DrandSourcePins.isPinned)

constants.name: BACKUP_AFTER_SECONDS
constants.source: V BoxBackedSource.sol (BACKUP_AFTER, 5 days): a quicknet round still unposted this long after its time may fall back to the RANDAO backup, started by anyone (F143 (2): 5 days, not 3), until BACKUP_LATEST_START_SECONDS

constants.name: BACKUP_LATEST_START_SECONDS
constants.source: V BoxBackedSource.sol (LATEST_START, 5 days 18 hours; the security review of sh-box0-backup-source, F1): the last moment after a round's time at which its backup may start; with the target BACKUP_TARGET_BLOCKS ahead and the fix inside EIP-2935's 8,191 blocks even the latest start's last word lands about 6.92 days after the request, inside DRAND_SILENCE_SECONDS: the cutoff keeps the whole proof window plus at least 1 h 50 min 21 s of margin at 12-second blocks (test/box/backup/BackupTimeline.t.sol); a later start could still be fixed early, but it would use up that margin and eventually push part of the proof window past the consumers' deadline

constants.name: BACKUP_RECENT_BLOCKS
constants.source: V BoxBackedSource.sol (RECENT_BLOCKS): the header a start proves (the format the fix relies on) may be one of the last 8 blocks', so a start included a few blocks late still lands (the security review, F3)

constants.name: BACKUP_TARGET_BLOCKS
constants.source: V BoxBackedSource.sol (TARGET_BLOCKS): the backup's target block is this many blocks after its start (about 51 minutes, 8 epochs: past the beacon chain's proposer lookahead); one target per round, never a second (F143; the review of the design study)

constants.name: DRAND_MARGIN_SECONDS
constants.source: V DrandSource.sol:68 (MARGIN): a word counts only from a round at least this long after the request

constants.name: DRAND_SILENCE_SECONDS
constants.source: V DrandSource.sol:70 (SILENCE, 7 days) = the placeholders add-on's SILENCE_DAYS (BoxTickets.sol:57): 7 silent days mean terminal mode

constants.name: DRAND_BOUNTY_GAS
constants.source: V DrandWords.sol:49 (BOUNTY_GAS): a round's posting bounty, BOUNTY_GAS × the block's base fee (about 0.0003 ETH at 0.5 gwei). R F75 W3 ('the draw pays the drand round's posting'): BoxTickets.draw requires it (DrandWords.payRound after its requests; BountyTooLow(pot + sent, needed)): the first draw of a round tops the round's pot up to the target, and the rest of the ETH sent goes back to the drawer (review of sh-f75, P; into the pot if the drawer refuses ETH), so later draws of that round get all they sent back; the pot pays whoever posts the round, usually the drawer's own page. The graduation word's request needs none (founder question 5, P)

stringRules.name: JSON_TEXT
stringRules.description: Printable ASCII 0x20-0x7E without '"' (0x22) or '\' (0x5C): the collection writes these strings into JSON unescaped. Control characters, DEL and every byte >= 0x80 (non-ASCII) are refused.
stringRules.source: V MisfitsCollection.sol:60-63 and :698 (the metadata table's rule); plan § 3.8; BC-072

stringRules.name: SVG
stringRules.description: Printable ASCII 0x20-0x7E. Quotes and backslashes are allowed: the picture is base64-encoded before it enters JSON (V MisfitsCollection.sol:485-486), and today's hidden picture uses double quotes (V PublicNames.sol COLLECTION_HIDDEN_IMAGE_SVG). Control characters and non-ASCII bytes are refused.
stringRules.source: plan § 1 (SVG <= 4,096); this file resolves the plan's conflict between 'every string without "' and box 0's own SVG

stringRules.name: URL
stringRules.description: A link: the URI characters of RFC 3986 (letters, digits and - . _ ~ : / ? # [ ] @ ! $ & ' ( ) * + , ; = %), so no space, '"', '<', '>', '\', '^', '`', '{', '|' or '}'; a non-empty link must start with https:// (BAD_CHARACTER otherwise). Written into contractURI's JSON unescaped.
stringRules.source: P (F71 (2)): contractURI's external_link (ERC-7572); https only, so no javascript: or data: link reaches a marketplace or the site

reasons.name: METADATA_TABLE_MALFORMED
reasons.meaning: the metadata table is not format v1 (BoxMetadataTable.validate's rules: version byte 1, the description, at most MAX_TRAIT_TYPES types, names and values of at least one byte, every text JSON_TEXT, nothing after the last value); checked after its length (core item 9)

fields.name: version
fields.note: The factory version. Version 1 builds only box 0 (template 0); version 2 everyone else (plan § 3.1).

fields.name: boxType
fields.note: F70 step 2 (Contents): 'A new collection' or 'Nothing' (TOKEN_ONLY, P: a plain token launch, version 2 only). A token-only spec carries zero in every collection field (each field's zeroWhen, MUST_BE_ZERO) and no collection add-on (their boxTypes, ADD_ON_CONFLICT).

fields.name: description
fields.note: F70 step 1 (Basics): the box's short description; for a new collection also contractURI's description.

fields.name: n
fields.note: Edition size; box 0: 4,269 (F49 E8). Token-only: 0 (no vault).

fields.name: q
fields.note: address(0) is native ETH. The caller passes the version's curated list (qListV1, qListV2, or a test list).

fields.name: raise
fields.note: Q raw units: the version's one raise for q (F74 U5: every box raises the same, 4.206980085 ETH 'equivalent of Q', box 0's R; replaces version 2's presets 1 / 4.2 / 10 ETH). The creator does not choose it: the page shows it as a fixed fact. The 'ETH equivalent' rule for other Q is open (S12; only native ETH is listed).

fields.name: gradLayout
fields.note: Chosen by the version: the spec must name a layout its version context lists (`contexts[].gradLayouts`), else NOT_OFFERED. L7 answered (F61, X2: the L7 layout only, no take cap): every product version lists exactly ASK_FULL_BID_SENTINEL, which the generator enforces; B_PRIME is NOT_OFFERED.

fields.name: openAt
fields.note: F80: the opening time, Unix seconds UTC (uint32, valid until 2106-02-07); 0 = Now. The first block whose timestamp is at or after openAt opens the window (WINDOW_SECONDS, 32 tax steps of TAX_STEP_SECONDS). Now, and a time the creation transaction lands at or after, open at the creation block's time + 1: the next block, never the creation block. 1 to MIN_OPEN_AT - 1 is OUT_OF_RANGE (a block count or delay typed in); the factory refuses a time more than MAX_OPEN_AHEAD_SECONDS after the creation block (OpenAtTooFar). Data, not code: it does not enter the template id, but the hook's address follows it (its salt is mined over it). Design: docs/design/open-at-clock-time.md.

fields.name: deadlineDays
fields.note: 0 = NONE (box 0 only, version 1); 30, 60, 90 or 180 for version 2 (F44 P6, F4; BC-045).

fields.name: qStream
fields.note: F70 step 3: the buyers' fee side's kind (creator, holders, burn) and the token it pays in. Holder payouts (F74 U1): offered in the Demo only, marked pending legal review (offeredOn), on Sepolia once S14 builds them, never on mainnet before counsel; validate() (this offered list) refuses them. Sepolia also leaves out what core v1 does not build for its boxes (notBuiltOn).

fields.name: tStream
fields.note: F70 step 3: the sellers' fee side, chosen independently of the buyers' side (F70 supersedes F68 (3)'s P 'both or neither'). Holder payouts as on the buyers' side (F74 U1): the Demo only, marked pending legal review, Sepolia once S14 builds them, never on mainnet before counsel; Sepolia also leaves out what core v1 does not build (notBuiltOn).

fields.name: artMode
fields.note: Token-only: 0 (no art), so neither art rule applies.

fields.name: metadataTable
fields.note: Format v1 (BoxMetadataTable: version byte 1, the description, at most MAX_TRAIT_TYPES (16) trait types, at most 255 values each, every text JSON_TEXT, nothing after the last value; V MisfitsCollection.sol:57-63). validate() checks the length, then the format (core item 9, built: METADATA_TABLE_MALFORMED for any table BoxMetadataTable.validate refuses), so createBox refuses a malformed table with a reason before the collection's own check at initialize would revert the creation (V BoxCollection.sol:115). No 2,048-byte cap on the box path (V: the coordinator writes the table as a data contract, BoxData; MAX_METADATA_TABLE_BYTES; that cap is v2's one-transaction genesis, script/v2/GenesisPlanning.sol:25). R F75 W1: box 0 stores every Misfit trait on chain, the full set (16 types, Character and Finish included; 3,341 bytes at round 7, test/vectors/box/misfits-trait-table-r7.json), built by scripts/box/misfits-trait-table.mjs from the commit-ready art; the fixture's one-type table is a stand-in until then.

fields.name: generatorHash
fields.note: Optional (zero = none); zero for a token-only box.

fields.name: coverSha256
fields.note: The logo, stored for good (K3): the token's and the box card's picture for every box type (F70 step 1). F74 U3: the logo only; a new collection's contractURI image is field 28 (collectionCoverSha256), its own upload (supersedes F70's P 'one picture for logo and cover'). No contract argument: the spec hash commits to it (the coordinator's specHash). The name stays coverSha256 so field 23's wire meaning keeps its number; no contract carries this name (the collection's cover view is collectionCoverSha256(), field 28).

fields.name: revealListId
fields.note: Open art: the stored reveal list (required); hidden art and token-only: zero (rules, zeroWhen).

fields.name: marketplaceOwner
fields.note: Returned by the collection's read-only owner(); box 0: the platform Safe (F44). Token-only: zero (no collection).

fields.name: creatorFeeRecipient
fields.note: F68 (3), F70, F72 (3): the initial creator payee, the box's one payout wallet: the reward side when the creator takes it on either side (qStream TO_CREATOR or CREATOR_IN_T, tStream TO_CREATOR or CREATOR_IN_Q) and royalties to CREATOR (add-on 4, which has no recipient of its own since core v1); non-zero exactly then, zero otherwise (rules). Paid as claims, like every payout (box-factory § 1.1 rule 6: pull, never push); handed over only at the payee's request (V BoxReceiverExtension.sol proposeCreatorPayee / acceptCreatorPayee; F72 (1)). Counsel flag kept (a creator earning from trading, F63 (2)). Cases BC-014, BC-111, BC-113.

fields.name: creatorBuy
fields.note: F61 O2, F66 X6: the creator's buy before the open, in Q raw units (0 = none), made in the creation transaction and shown on the box page from the spec. No cap (F61 O2; F66: a cap or lock is optional, not applied). Rules: zero for box 0 (version 1); below `raise`, so it can never fill the curve before the open (P: the factory, S11, re-checks the exact fill against the curve). Cases BC-116, BC-117.

fields.name: collectionCoverSha256
fields.note: F74 U3: the collection cover, stored for good (K3), contractURI's image = ipfs:// + rawCidV1(collectionCoverSha256) (BC-054): the collection clone's cover argument (V BoxCloneArgs.sol:42 C_COLLECTION_COVER_SHA256, BoxCollection.sol:165-187); on chain it carries this field's name: BoxCollection.collectionCoverSha256() and CollectionInitialized's collectionCoverSha256 (renamed from coverSha256 before any deployment, SH-F74-polish), never field 23's. Its own upload in the launch flow, no 'same as logo' shortcut (the founder chose a separate picture). Zero for a token-only box (no collection). Also the picture of every not-yet-revealed item in an open-art box (no hidden picture there: V BoxCollection._hiddenJSON, test_hiddenViewOfOpenArtIsTheCover); hidden art shows the placeholders add-on's picture instead. P, founder question: the collection cover or the logo (field 23) for those items (U3 decided only the marketplace picture). Box 0: the FIT icon, today's contractURI image (MisfitsCollection.sol:115-116), the same picture as its logo until the founder picks another (P). Appended before the add-on list so fields 1-27 keep their ids.

fields.name: addOns
fields.note: Ascending ids; a repeatable add-on may appear more than once. Catalog: add-ons.v1.json.

notInTheSpec.name: hookSalt
notInTheSpec.why: Passed beside the spec to createBox(spec, hookSalt) (plan § 3.1). It is mined over the hook clone's final init-code hash, which depends on addresses salted with the spec hash; inside the spec it would be circular.

notInTheSpec.name: links (website, X, Telegram)
notInTheSpec.why: Site metadata (F70 step 1), not a box parameter: links change, a spec is fixed for good. They live in the box's site record, keyed by the spec hash and the box's token address: today in the downloaded BoxSpec file (`site.links`) and the Demo record (created-boxes); with the factory, in the site's content pack for the box (hook point site.packByCollection, S10a; by address, never by name, BC-095), editable later by the creator with a signed message (P, S10b). The site shows https links only, as plain text plus a link with rel="noopener noreferrer". The one fixed link is contractURI's external_link (add-on 6).

notInTheSpec.name: rights confirmation
notInTheSpec.why: A statement about the creator, not a box parameter (F70 step 5): the checkbox 'I own the rights and impersonate no one' is a site-level record { specHash, creator address, statement version, confirmedAt } made by the explicit Create press, kept with the box's site record (BoxSpec file `site.rights`, the Demo record; with the factory, the site's store, tied to the creator by the creation transaction they send, P). Create stays off until it is checked. Counsel words the statement.

notInTheSpec.name: banner and teaser bytes
notInTheSpec.why: As the cover: by hash only (add-on 6, bannerSha256 and teaserSha256s), each picture one raw IPFS block (<= 1 MiB) stored with the cover by default; the downloaded BoxSpec file carries their bytes (base64) like the cover's (F71 (2)).

notInTheSpec.name: full-collection storage
notInTheSpec.why: A paid creation option (BC-093, S13), open art only: what is stored, not what the box is.

notInTheSpec.name: hiddenSvg
notInTheSpec.why: Moved into the placeholders add-on's params (F55): the hidden picture belongs to hidden art, not to the core.

notInTheSpec.name: cover picture (its bytes)
notInTheSpec.why: The spec names its pictures by hash alone: the logo by coverSha256 (field 23) and, since F74 U3, the collection cover by collectionCoverSha256 (field 28). Each picture is stored for good off chain as one raw IPFS block (plan § 3.1; F53 K3: the cover permanent by default) and contractURI's image link derives from the collection cover's hash: ipfs:// + MisfitsEncoding.rawCidV1(collectionCoverSha256) (V MisfitsEncoding.sol:58-64, the link revealed items already use at MisfitsCollection.sol:494; BC-054, 'any box', S3). So no picture bytes enter the spec or the creation gas, and the hash check is the link itself. Box 0 differs from today: MisfitsCollection.sol:300-318 embeds the FIT icon inline (711 bytes, base64); under BC-054 its contractURI links the raw block of the same bytes (sha256 2aa8e531…da69c93, the value MisfitsCollection.sol:115-116 names; vitest checks fit-icon.svg, PublicNames.sol's COLLECTION_IMAGE_SVG and the fixture agree). An inline cover, if S3 or the founder wants one, is an add-on (F55), not a core field, with a string rule that allows LF (0x0A): the FIT icon holds 6 LF bytes, which the SVG rule refuses.

notInTheSpec.name: window, tax table, fees, fee shares, the platform cap, batches, executor bounds, timers, randomness source, FIT's executor, platform Safe
notInTheSpec.why: Fixed per version, never per box (plan § 1): in `constants` (each with status V or P and the slice that builds or fixes it; the randomness source is RANDOMNESS_SOURCE with RANDOMNESS_SOURCE_CODE_HASH, V, S9), the placeholders add-on's constants (the ticket timers, V MisfitsPlaceholders.sol:178-186) and `fixedLater` (FIT's executor address, S7). The curated Q list, the raise (one per Q, F74 U5) and the graduated layout are in each version context. Where each box's sniper tax goes is fixed too (`about`, fee model): every box's sniper tax goes into the box itself: its own pool after graduation, or the refund range at a failure in version 2; box 0 has no failure path (F68 (2a), F77).

rules.name: a token-only box is version 2
rules.source: P (F70): version 1 builds only box 0 (plan § 3.1); 'Nothing' is a choice for other people's boxes

rules.name: version 1 has no deadline
rules.source: F44 F4; plan § 1 (NONE only in box 0's spec); BC-064

rules.name: BURN_Q only for a Q with a real burn
open art publishes its reveal list
hidden art keeps its reveal list private
rules.source: P (S1): a published list would reveal hidden art at creation

rules.name: hidden art needs the placeholders add-on
rules.source: F55: hidden art revealed by draws is the placeholders add-on; its picture, texts and safety net come with it

rules.name: the per-item stream action needs its add-on
the creator option on the buyers' side is for other people's boxes
rules.source: F68 (3) ('for other people's boxes'); F77: box 0's split is 11/15 FIT, 2/15 its own pool, 2/15 platform (capped); F70: per fee side. Replaces 'the creator takes the whole reward side or none of it' (F68 (3), P), which F70 supersedes

rules.name: the creator option on the sellers' side is for other people's boxes
the creator option names its recipient
rules.source: F68 (3); F70: a creator kind on either side; F72 (3) and core v1: royalties to CREATOR are paid to the same payee (add-on 4 has no recipient; V BoxReceiverExtension.sol `initialize`)

rules.name: no fee recipient without the creator option
rules.source: P (fee-model pass): one spec, one meaning; a recipient nobody is paid would only mislead the box page

rules.name: box 0 has no creator buy
rules.source: F61 O2 allows a creator buy before the open for other people's boxes only; box 0 (version 1) has none

rules.name: the creator buy cannot fill the curve
rules.source: P (fee-model pass): a buy of the raise would close the curve before it opens (D1); after the 1% LP fee anything below the raise leaves part of the curve open. No other cap (F61 O2, F66 X6)
